fpi_sector_3m.text: FPI net equity flow over the last 3 months (6 NSDL fortnights) is at least 1.5% of the sector's FPI equity holdings, in either direction.
fpi_sector_3m.mechanism: Foreign portfolio investors' disclosed net equity buying or selling in the sector

mf_sector_breadth.text: Fund-house net breadth (adds+new minus trims+exits, as % of all moves, active schemes, latest month vs previous) is at least +40% or at most -40%, with 10 or more moves.
mf_sector_breadth.mechanism: Breadth of domestic fund-house position changes in the sector's stocks

mf_stock_breadth.text: Three or more fund houses moved the same way in one stock in the latest month (net count of fund houses adding/new minus trimming/exiting).
mf_stock_breadth.mechanism: Several fund houses changed positions in the same company in the same month

rating_balance_90d.text: Over the 90 days to the agency's latest action, (upgrades - downgrades) / (upgrades + downgrades) is at least +0.6 or at most -0.6, with 6 or more of them. Defaults are listed but kept out of the balance (many are small-borrower 'D' moves). Each agency separately; 'Issuer Not Cooperating' moves excluded.
rating_balance_90d.mechanism: Balance of credit-rating upgrades and downgrades among the sector's rated borrowers

bank_credit_yoy.text: Outstanding bank credit to the sector (RBI SIBC, mapped codes, outstanding-weighted) grew 25% or more year on year, or did not grow (0% or less).
bank_credit_yoy.mechanism: Pace of bank lending to the sector (outstanding credit, not new sanctions)

inst_breadth_qoq.text: Share of the sector's companies whose institutional holding rose quarter on quarter is 65% or more, or 35% or less (10 or more companies).
inst_breadth_qoq.mechanism: Breadth of institutional holding increases across the sector's listed companies

inst_share_company.text: Institutional holding of a Nifty 500 company changed by 3 percentage points or more quarter on quarter (NSE shareholding pattern).
inst_share_company.mechanism: Change in the institutional share of the company's equity

fin_company_quarter.text: Nifty 500 company, latest reported quarter vs the same quarter a year earlier (same basis): revenue +20% or more with EBITDA margin not lower (lenders/insurers: profit after tax +20% or more), or revenue -10% or less, or EBITDA margin down 5 pp or more. Not emitted when revenue rose 25%+ while margin fell 5 pp+ at the same time (usually a presentation change such as duties included in revenue), or when year-ago quarterly revenue was below Rs 100 crore (small-base effects). A quarter tagged only as year-to-date is derived from year-to-date differences.
fin_company_quarter.mechanism: Reported revenue and operating margin of the company (exchange XBRL filing)

fin_sector_revenue.text: Sum of the sector's Nifty 500 company revenues in the latest quarter vs the same quarter a year earlier (companies with both quarters, 5 or more) grew 15% or more, or did not grow.
fin_sector_revenue.mechanism: Aggregate reported revenue of the sector's listed companies

fin_sector_margin.text: Aggregate EBITDA margin of the sector's non-financial Nifty 500 companies changed by 1.5 percentage points or more vs the same quarter a year earlier (5 or more companies).
fin_sector_margin.mechanism: Aggregate reported operating (EBITDA) margin of the sector's listed companies

iip_sector_3m.text: Average year-on-year growth over the latest 3 months of the IIP industries mapped to the sector (MoSPI, base 2022-23) is 8% or more, or -2% or less.
iip_sector_3m.mechanism: Industrial production volumes in the industries mapped to the sector (MoSPI IIP)

trade_export_fy.text: India's merchandise exports in the HS chapters mapped to the sector grew 15% or more, or fell 10% or more, in the latest financial year (TradeStat, US$).
trade_export_fy.mechanism: India's merchandise exports in the sector's mapped HS chapters

trade_import_share.text: Imports as a share of two-way trade (imports / (imports + exports)) in the sector's mapped HS chapters moved by 3 percentage points or more in the latest financial year (US$ 1 bn+ of trade). Higher = more reliance on imports in that trade.
trade_import_share.mechanism: Reliance on imports in the sector's mapped merchandise trade

capacity_utilisation.text: RBI OBICUS seasonally adjusted manufacturing capacity utilisation for the latest quarter is 75% or more, or 70% or less.
capacity_utilisation.mechanism: How fully manufacturers' installed capacity is being used (RBI survey)

commodity_3m.text: A tracked commodity price (IMF primary commodity series via FRED; Brent from EIA via FRED) moved 15% or more over 3 months (latest monthly value vs 3 months earlier). IMF series are published with about a 6-8 week lag; the period is the month the average covers.
commodity_3m.mechanism: Global commodity price move that changes input costs or realisations for exposed sectors
